import.title: Import contacts
import.description: Bring in the spreadsheet you already keep. We match the columns, find people who are already in your contacts by phone, and show you every row before anything is saved.

upload.orChoose: or <choose>choose a file</choose> from your computer
upload.limits: CSV with column names in the first row, up to 5,000 rows
upload.sampleDescription: Try a sample of 25 clinic patients. Three are already in your contacts and two have typos in their phone numbers.
upload.tipHeader: One person per row, with column names in the first row.
upload.tipColumns: We recognise columns like Name, Mobile, WhatsApp, Email, Company, Job title and Notes.
upload.tipPhones: Numbers without a country code are read as UAE numbers: 050 123 4567 becomes +971 50 123 4567.
upload.tipSafe: Nothing is saved until you confirm the review.

problems.not_csv: This isn't a CSV file. In Excel or Google Sheets, save or download the sheet as CSV, then try again.
problems.no_header: We couldn't find column names. Put them in the first row of the file and try again.
problems.no_rows: This file has column names but no rows under them.
problems.too_many: This file has more than 5,000 rows. Split it into smaller files and import them one at a time.
problems.unreadable: We couldn't read this file. Save it again as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.

map.title: Match your columns
map.description: We matched what we could from your column names. Check each one, and choose Don't import for columns you don't need.
map.needsName: Match a column to Full name or First name to continue.
map.noPhone: Without a phone column, duplicates are found by email only and WhatsApp chats can't start from these contacts.
